stories.title: 尼日利亚西北部袭击事件致22人死亡

en.title: 22 killed in attack in northwestern Nigeria
en.summary: An attack in Zamfara State in northwestern Nigeria on the 11th resulted in 22 deaths. Attackers looted three villages and set fire to 12 vehicles while security personnel were present at the scene.

stories.title: 欧盟将俄罗斯近1600名个人和实体列为制裁对象

en.title: EU designates nearly 1,600 Russian individuals and entities as sanctions targets
en.summary: The European Union announced additional sanctions against Russia on the 12th, placing 1,569 Russian individuals and entities on its sanctions list.

stories.title: Israel pupil, 15, killed, over 20 hurt, after suspected leftover bomb detonates

en.title: Israel pupil, 15, killed, over 20 hurt, after suspected leftover bomb detonates
en.summary: An Israeli teenager died and more than 20 people were injured when a suspected unexploded Hezbollah cluster munition from fighting three years earlier detonated during a hiking excursion near the Lebanese border.

stories.title: 世界最大室外冰雪主题乐园今冬规划园区面积规模创新高

en.title: World's largest outdoor ice and snow theme park plans record-breaking scale for this winter
en.summary: Harbin Ice and Snow World announced plans to expand its park area to 1.25 million square meters for the 2026-2027 season, marking a new record. The facility will feature over 1,000 ice and snow structures and add a new oversized ice slide.

stories.title: 纪念中国侨联成立70周年专题音乐会在北京举行

en.title: Concert held in Beijing to mark 70th anniversary of China Overseas Chinese Association
en.summary: A commemorative concert celebrating the 70th anniversary of the China Overseas Chinese Association took place in Beijing, attended by over 800 overseas Chinese representatives and returnees.

stories.title: 广交会首次推出境外采购商会员服务

en.title: Canton Fair introduces overseas buyer membership services for first time
en.summary: The 140th China Import and Export Commodities Fair will open October 15, featuring new initiatives including overseas buyer membership services, a supplier alliance, and a combined exhibition and overseas livestream model.

stories.title: 武网首轮上演中国“金花”德比 王曦雨晋级次轮

en.title: Wang Xiyu advances to second round after defeating Wang Xinyu in Chinese tennis derby at Wuhan Open
en.summary: At the 2026 Wuhan Open, Wang Xiyu defeated fellow Chinese player Wang Xinyu in straight sets to advance to the women's singles second round in a highly anticipated match.

stories.title: 马来西亚教育部扩大烟霾停课范围

en.title: Malaysia's Education Ministry expands school closures due to haze
en.summary: Malaysia's Education Ministry announced expanded haze-related school closure measures affecting multiple states and federal territories, with some regions switching to home-based learning through October 16.

stories.title: 琼瑶童年四川往事将拍成短剧

en.title: Qiong Yao's childhood experiences in Sichuan to be adapted into short drama series
en.summary: A Taiwanese cultural company announced plans to adapt the childhood memories of writer Qiong Yao spent in Sichuan province into a short drama series. The project represents a cross-strait collaboration in China's short drama production sector.

stories.title: 王毅与俄罗斯总统助理、海事委员会主席帕特鲁舍夫举行会晤

en.title: Wang Yi meets with Russian presidential aide and maritime committee chair Patrushev
en.summary: China's top diplomat Wang Yi held a meeting with Sergei Patrushev, a senior aide to Russia's president and chair of its maritime commission, in Beijing on October 12.

stories.title: Garden Company apologises after crowd chaos mars student sandwich record bid

en.title: Garden Company apologises after crowd chaos mars student sandwich record bid
en.summary: A Hong Kong bread and biscuit manufacturer apologized following disorder during an attempt to set a world record for the largest sandwich-making lesson involving over 700 students at a secondary school.

stories.title: 中外专家考察平陆运河 探访工程建设经验

en.title: Chinese and international experts inspect Pingluo Canal, exploring engineering construction experience
en.summary: Delegates from the World Canal Conference visited the Pingluo Canal, a major project under China's western land-sea trade corridor, to examine construction methods and water management techniques applied in the project.

stories.title: Hong Kong to expand indices, derivatives and yuan-denominated products: HKEX CEO

en.title: Hong Kong to expand indices, derivatives and yuan-denominated products: HKEX CEO
en.summary: HKEX plans to introduce new measures including yuan-denominated gold futures and stock trading to increase market liquidity, attract international investors, and promote greater use of China's currency as Hong Kong reinforces its role as a global financial centre.

stories.title: Few Hong Kong investors take interest in listing by Africa’s top phone maker Transsion

en.title: Few Hong Kong investors take interest in listing by Africa's top phone maker Transsion
en.summary: Transsion Holdings' HK$3.36 billion Hong Kong IPO attracted modest interest with roughly 3.5 times oversubscription and about 14,000 applications during bookbuilding. The lukewarm response raises concerns about market sentiment for fourth-quarter new listings.

stories.title: Former HSBC executive launches wealth platform powered by team of AI agents

en.title: Former HSBC executive launches wealth platform powered by team of AI agents
en.summary: Trista Sun, a former HSBC managing director, has launched Equora, an AI-driven wealth management start-up targeting a billion-dollar valuation. The platform aims to help investors manage finances proactively through artificial intelligence agents.

stories.title: China bets on molten salt and CO2 to help meet its power needs

en.title: China bets on molten salt and CO2 to help meet its power needs
en.summary: China is constructing the world's first utility-scale power plant combining supercritical CO2 generation and molten salt energy storage in Yantai. The Ruitan project aims to reduce energy wastage and improve electrical grid stability.

stories.title: Brake-pedal failures in luxury EV put Chinese cars’ quality in regulatory spotlight

en.title: Brake-pedal failures in luxury EV put Chinese cars' quality in regulatory spotlight
en.summary: Safety testing revealed brake-pedal failures in a Huawei-backed luxury EV, raising quality concerns. Chinese regulators have published draft rules to strengthen testing and oversight of new car models.
